name: George
appearance: Her hands are calloused from harvest work, with soil permanently under her nails. She wears a practical brown chiton hitched up for field work, with a wide straw hat that casts gentle shadows over her sun-bronzed face. A woven belt holds seed pouches and a small pruning knife, while a basket for gathering sits on her hip. Her hair is braided back with wheat stalks, and she often carries fresh vegetables or herbs from her garden.
